events.title: 케니 달글리시 makes his final appearance for 리버풀 at the age of 39, in their 1–0 home league win over 더비 카운티 . The only goal of the game comes from Gary Gillespie . 셰필드 유나이티드 miss the chance to seal promotion to the First Division, being held to a goalless draw by 블랙번 로버스 at Ewood Park .

셰필드 웬즈데이 are relegated on goal difference behind 루턴 타운, who win their final game of the season 3–2 at 더비 카운티 while the Hillsborough club lose 3–0 at home to 노팅엄 포리스트. 리버풀's season ends in style with a 6–1 away win over 코번트리 시티, and 토트넘 홋스퍼 pip 아스널 to third place by one point. 셰필드 유나이티드 seal promotion back to the First Division after 14 years away. Dave Bassett achieves the sixth promotion of his career with a Blades side who finished level on points with champions 리즈 유나이티드. 리즈 유나이티드's promotion celebrations are marred when their fans riot in 본머스 in the aftermath of the promotion clinching game against 본머스 , who were relegated by the result.

맨체스터 유나이티드 and 크리스털 팰리스 draw 3–3 in the FA Cup final , forcing a replay. Mark Hughes is on the scoresheet twice for United and Bryan Robson once. Substitute Ian Wright scores two of Palace's goals, the other goal coming from Gary O'Reilly .
유벤투스 win the two-legged 1990 UEFA Cup Final , beating fellow Italian side 피오렌티나 3–1 on aggregate. This was the first European competition final between two Italian clubs.
A Lee Martin goal gives 맨체스터 유나이티드 the FA Cup in a 1–0 replay victory over 크리스털 팰리스.
맨체스터 유나이티드 beats 크리스털 팰리스 1–0 in a replay to claim the FA Cup . The only goal is scored by Lee Martin .
David Seaman becomes Britain's most expensive goalkeeper when he agrees to join 아스널 in a £1.3 million move from 퀸스 파크 레인저스.
첼시 sign Irish midfielder Andy Townsend from 노리치 시티 for £1.5 million.

34 볼턴 원더러스 hooligans who were convicted of taking part in attacks on police officers and rival supporters are banned from travelling to Italy for the duration of the World Cup by the Italian government.
AC 밀란 beats 벤피카 1–0 in the 1990 European Cup Final . The only goal is scored by 프랑크 레이카르트 .
Bobby Robson announces that he will step down as England manager after the World Cup to take over as manager of Dutch side PSV 에인트호번 .

스윈던 타운 win the Second Division playoff final by beating 선덜랜드 1–0, but their place in the First Division remains in doubt over the alleged tax scandal, over which Colin Calderwood has now been cleared but Lou Macari, Brian Hillier and Vince Farrar have been charged.

애스턴 빌라 chairman Doug Ellis gives the Football Association permission to interview manager Graham Taylor for the England manager's job. Other names linked to the vacancy included Howard Wilkinson of 리즈 유나이티드, Terry Venables of 토트넘 홋스퍼, Howard Kendall of 맨체스터 시티 and the surprise candidate Joe Royle of 올덤 애슬레틱, who has yet to manage in the top division.
